page_title: Automater Lite: All your AI sessions. One place.

sources.entry: AUTOMATER.ai - Tray app that keeps track of every AI coding agent you run: a searchable library of past sessions, a flag when an agent is waiting on you, and usage across 9 providers. #freemium

summary.name: Automater Lite
summary.one_liner: A free tray app that indexes the session history of AI coding CLIs and desktop apps into one local searchable library, flags when an agent needs you, and shows usage across 9 providers.
use_cases: Searching past coding agent sessions across many tools
Spotting which AI agent is waiting on a permission prompt
Tracking usage and plan limits across several AI providers
Dictating prompts into Claude Code or a terminal
Keeping a local archive of AI assistant transcripts
summary.what_it_does: Automater Lite reads the session files that 41 AI CLIs and desktop apps already save on disk (45 formats) and indexes them into a local searchable library. A tray panel lets you search sessions, reopen some of them in their own CLI (11 of the supported tools), see which agent is waiting on you, and check one usage meter covering 9 providers. It also offers local voice dictation via a hotkey and spoken status alerts for Claude Code. Paid PRO adds actions such as managed sessions, computer control, Fleet view and cloud voice.
notable: Indexes session history from 41 AI CLIs and desktop apps into one local library
Flags when an agent is waiting on you and can speak status aloud via local voice
Free Lite tier with no sign-up; optional yearly PRO upgrade at $50/year introductory price
caveats: macOS build is Apple silicon only; no Intel Mac build yet
Several PRO features are marked BETA (built-in tools, Fleet, Camera FX)
Some features such as one-click resume are limited to 11 of the supported tools
Cloud voice and computer control require the paid PRO tier
